Name: No Cuties in the Monster Slayer Goals
Author: ClawClawClaw
Description:
Tired of having to slay 150 of Krobus's relatives? Feel bad chasing the cute little dust sprites as they run away from you? Think slimes are sorta cute? Feel weird about having a dino in your coop while hunting down other dinos? Well here is the perfect mod for you! This mod replaces those 4 goals with other (less cute) monsters.

The replacements are as follows:
[i]1000 slimes -> 200 bugs
150 shadows -> 300 bats
500 dust sprites -> 75 skeletons
50 dinos -> 100 serpents[/i]

[b][u]FAQ:[/u][/b]

[b]Is this mod compatible with other mods?[/b]
Yes! It should be compatible with pretty much everything that doesn't also edit the monster slayer goal list.

[b]Can I add this in the middle of my playthrough?[/b]
Yes! It is safe to add (or remove) at any time.

[b]How does this work?[/b]
It is a simple replacement using Content Patcher.

[b]Are the rewards from Gil the same?[/b]
Yes! The alternate goals have the same rewards as the original goals did.

[b]Why are there duplicates in the goal list?[/b]
Having multiple goals with different numbers of the same monsters works fine and allows me to avoid having goals for monsters that are too rare. It also means this mod shouldn't require any translations to work in all languages the game supports.
